notes: Vine on the west edge, Walnut on the east. Commerce Street (printed COMMERCE, 25') runs east from Vine to Walnut, ending at Walnut (T from the west); the leg west of Vine (also printed COMMERCE, Volume 1 side) is offset about 70 px (20 ft) south, so Vine has two Commerce Street T points: y 1322 for the east leg and y 1395 for the west leg. The approach to the Covington and Cincinnati Suspension Bridge (printed APPROACH TO BRIDGE; walls at about x 2212 and 2444, centreline x about 2328) lands at grade on E. 2nd and is carried over Commerce (DRIVE UNDER), E. Front and E. Water on arches with storage rooms under; those grade-separated crossings are not recorded as intersections. Neff Alley (10') runs 2nd to Commerce only. Clark Alley (printed ALLEY with a width figure that reads as 10', about 37 px between faces) runs east from Vine. Giffin Street enters from the east and ends at Walnut; no width printed. Sheet carries paste-over corrections into the 1920s (filling station, garages).
